title: West Pakistan Administration Merger of the Federal Territory of Karachi Order 1961

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Administration Merger of the Federal Territory of Karachi Order 1961
sections.section: ORDER - West Pakistan Administration (Merger of the Federal Territory of Karachi) Order 1961
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER No
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
No. 9 OF 1961
WEST PAKISTAN
ADMINISTRATION (MERGER OF THE
FEDERAL TERRITORY
OF KARACHI) ORDER, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 29th June 1961]
Whereas the Federal Territory of
Karachi is to be merged into the Province of West Pakistan ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the seventh day of October 1958, and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the
following Order :-
1. (1) This Order may be
called the West Pakistan Administration (Merger of the Federal Territory of
Karachi) Order, 1961.
(2) It shall come into force on
such date, hereinafter referred to as "the appointed day", as the
Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
2. The territories
hitherto known as the Federal Territory of Karachi (hereinafter referred to as
the Specified Territory) shall as from the appointed day be a part of West
Pakistan.
3. The Specified Territory
shall, with effect from the appointed day, cease to be administered as Federal
Territory and be known as the Karachi Division of West Pakistan and
administered accordingly.
4. As from the appointed
day any reference to the Specified Territory in any Act or Ordinance or in any
rule, regulation, order, bye-law or notifica tion shall be construed as a
reference to the Province of West Pakistan, or as the context may indicate, to
the Karachi Division.
5. Except as otherwise
provided in this Order, all laws, including Acts, Ordinances, Orders, bye-laws,
rules, regulations and notifications, in force in the Specified Territory or
any part thereof immediately before the appointed day, shall, so far as
applicable, and with the necessary adaptations, continue in force, until
altered, repealed or amended, by competent authority.
6. Notwithstanding
anything contained in the foregoing provisions of this Order-
(1) the proceeds of all taxes,
revenues and other moneys payable to the Federal Consolidated Fund or the
Public Account of the Federation in accordance with the laws in force
immediately before, the appointed day shall continue to be so payable;
(2) all properties and assets
which immediately before such day vested in the Central Government shall
continue to be so vested ; and
(3) all rights, liabilities and
obligations of the Central Government relating to properties and assets or to
contracts, debts or payment or receipt of money, accrued or incurred
immediately before the appointed day, shall continue to be the rights,
liabilities and obligations of the Central Government.
7. (1) As soon as may be
after the appointed day, the President shall appoint a Committee of such
members as he thinks fit to make recommenda tions as to-
(a) which of the taxes, revenues
and other moneys referred to in Article 6 should continue to be payable to the
Federal Consolidated Fund for the Public Account of the Federation and which of
such taxes, revenues and other moneys should be payable to the Provincial
Consolidated Fund or the Public Account of the Province of West Pakistan ; and
(b) the apportionment and
adjustment of properties, assets, rights, liabilities and obligations referred
to in Article 6 between the Central Government and the Government of West
Pakistan.
(2) The President shall pass such
orders relating to the matters referred to in clause (1) as he thinks fit
taking into consideration the recommendations of the Committee.
8. (1) All persons serving
immediately before the appointed day under the Central Government in connection
with such affairs of the Specified Territory as would have been the affairs of
the Province had the Specified Territory been a Governor's Province, shall, as
from such day, be deemed to be persons serving under the Government of West
Pakistan.
